abstract: OBJECTIVE: Sacrococcygeal teratoma is an extragonadal germ cell tumor that develops during fetal and neonatal periods and is associated with significant perinatal morbidity and even mortality. This study aimed to determine the clinicopathologic characteristics, the clinical outcomes, and postoperative complications of sacrococcygeal teratoma cases in the low-volume pediatric surgery service in a developing country. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The study included data from all sacrococcygeal teratoma cases diagnosed from 2011 to 2020. All the relevant clinicopathologic data were recorded and analyzed. RESULTS: A total of 7 pediatric (5 females and 2 males) patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma were identified, ranging in age from 3 to 222 days. A prenatal diagnosis was made in 57.1% of cases. The mean gestational age for all cases was 37.1 weeks (34-38 weeks), and the mean birth weight was 3285 g (range, 2300-4700 g). Preoperative alpha-fetoprotein levels had a mean value of 24.327 ng/mL (range, 649.7-110.600 ng/mL). The surgery involved resection of the primary tumor and coccygectomy in all cases. Three (42.9%) tumors were classified as Altman type II lesions, 2 (28.6%) tumors were type IV, and 2 remaining cases were types I and III, respectively. Histology was benign in 4 (57.1%) and immature in 3 patients (42.9%). The mean follow-up time was 101.4 months (30-146 months), with 2 recurrences of high-grade immature teratomas at 11 and 30 months following the surgery. Three patients had postoperative bladder and rectal dysfunctions. CONCLUSION: Sacrococcygeal teratomas are rare tumors associated with frequent postoperative dysfunctions. Recurrences may also be seen, particularly in immature, high-grade forms of sacrococcygeal teratomas.
abstract_ja: 目的：仙尾部奇形腫は、胎児期および新生児期に発生する性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であり、周産期の重大な罹患率や死亡にも関連する。本研究は、開発途上国の小規模小児外科部門における仙尾部奇形腫症例の臨床病理学的特徴、臨床転帰、術後合併症を明らかにすることを目的とした。材料と方法：2011年から2020年に診断されたすべての仙尾部奇形腫症例のデータを含めた。関連するすべての臨床病理学的データを記録し、解析した。結果：仙尾部奇形腫の小児7例(女児5例、男児2例)を同定し、年齢は3日から222日であった。出生前診断は57.1%の症例で行われた。全症例の平均在胎週数は37.1週(34〜38週)、平均出生体重は3285g(範囲2300〜4700g)であった。術前のαフェトプロテイン値の平均は24.327ng/mL(範囲649.7〜110.600ng/mL)であった。手術はすべての症例で原発腫瘍の切除と尾骨切除を含んだ。3例(42.9%)の腫瘍はAltman II型病変に分類され、2例(28.6%)はIV型、残りの2例はそれぞれI型とIII型であった。組織学的所見は4例(57.1%)が良性、3例(42.9%)が未熟であった。平均追跡期間は101.4か月(30〜146か月)で、未熟な高悪性度奇形腫の再発が手術後11か月と30か月に2例認められた。3例で術後の膀胱および直腸機能障害が認められた。結論：仙尾部奇形腫はまれな腫瘍であり、術後の機能障害を高頻度に伴う。特に未熟で高悪性度の仙尾部奇形腫では再発もみられうる。
